deals.comment: GS Energy Corporation agreed to acquire 50% stake in GS Park 24 Co., Ltd. from GS Caltex Corp. for KRW 10.3 billion on June 20, 2013. GS Energy will acquire 2.3 million shares for KRW 4,495.2 per share. The Board of Directors of GS Park 24 passed a resolution for the transaction on June 20, 2013. The transaction is expected to close on June 28, 2013.

GS Retail Co., Ltd. (KOSE:A007070) entered into an agreement to acquire 50% stake in GSPark24.Co.,Ltd from PARK24 Co., Ltd. (TSE:4666) for KRW 25 million on August 31, 2021. The transaction is expected to close on September 15, 2021.

deals.sellers: PARK24 Co., Ltd. (TSE:4666); GS Retail Co., Ltd. (KOSE:A007070)
deals.comment: Kakao Mobility Co., Ltd. acquired GSPark24.Co.,Ltd from PARK24 Co., Ltd. (TSE:4666), and GS Retail Co., Ltd. (KOSE:A007070) for KRW 65 billion on December 8, 2021.
